shared_elements: raised/bent arm with hand and fingers rendered in relief
horizontal band or register of repeated small elements
quadruped animal in profile (B) alongside animal-derived attributes (A)
justification: Both surfaces carry figural low relief with profile-oriented bodies, an arm with splayed fingers, and a horizontal band of small repeated units (an inscription-like strip in A, a row of small motifs in B), but these are generic relief conventions rather than a shared motif. A shows a single large anthropomorphic winged, bearded figure with a horned headdress attending a rosette-laden plant, while B shows stacked registers of schematic animals, birds and quadrupeds with no human protagonist or plant, so the depicted subjects and their relationships differ almost entirely.
